question: Study all genes expressed in salivary gland according to HPA consensus RNA data. Report the cohort size, counts by RNA tissue specificity category, the number of FDA approved drug targets and counts measured by blood immunoassay, by mass spectrometry, by both and by neither. Among cohort genes secreted to blood, rank twelve by log2((salivary gland nTPM+1)/(liver nTPM+1)), ties by Ensembl ID. Give their consensus nTPM in salivary gland, liver, pancreas and kidney, their specificity categories and the available blood concentrations. Draw a specificity-category bar chart, a blood-assay-coverage chart and the four-tissue heatmap; provide the tables. If a requested ranked list has fewer eligible members, return every eligible member and state the count. Use Ensembl genes present in the HPA master table as the gene universe and break all gene-ranking ties by Ensembl ID.

turns.text: The gene universe is 20,162 Ensembl genes, all present in the master table. Now let me build the salivary-gland cohort (nTPM ≥ 1) and compute the summary statistics.

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input:
{"query": "WITH sg AS (
  SELECT Gene, TRY_CAST(nTPM AS DOUBLE) AS ntpm
  FROM rna_tissue_consensus WHERE Tissue='salivary gland'
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT sg.Gene, sg.ntpm, p."RNA tissue specificity" AS spec, p."Protein class" AS pc,
         p."Secretome location" AS sec
  FROM sg JOIN proteinatlas p ON sg.Gene=p.Ensembl
  WHERE sg.ntpm >= 1
)
SELECT 'cohort_size' AS metric, CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) AS value FROM cohort
UNION ALL
SELECT 'FDA_'||spec, CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) FROM cohort
WHERE pc LIKE '%FDA approved drug targets%'
GROUP BY spec
ORDER BY metric"}

{"query": "WITH sg AS (

  FROM rna_tissue_consensus WHERE Tissue='salivary gland'

cohort AS (

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort) AS cohort_size,

turns.text: Now let me build the ranked list of salivary-gland cohort genes secreted to blood, ranked by log2((salivary gland+1)/(liver+1)).

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input:
{"query": "WITH sg AS (SELECT Gene, TRY_CAST(nTPM AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM rna_tissue_consensus WHERE Tissue='salivary gland'),
lv AS (SELECT Gene, TRY_CAST(nTPM AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM rna_tissue_consensus WHERE Tissue='liver'),
pa AS (SELECT Gene, TRY_CAST(nTPM AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM rna_tissue_consensus WHERE Tissue='pancreas'),
ki AS (SELECT Gene, TRY_CAST(nTPM AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM rna_tissue_consensus WHERE Tissue='kidney'),
cohort AS (
  SELECT sg.Gene, sg.v AS sg_ntpm, lv.v AS lv_ntpm, pa.v AS pa_ntpm, ki.v AS ki_ntpm,
         p."Gene name" AS gname, p."RNA tissue specificity" AS spec
  FROM sg
  JOIN proteinatlas p ON sg.Gene=p.Ensembl
  LEFT JOIN lv ON sg.Gene=lv.Gene
  LEFT JOIN pa ON sg.Gene=pa.Gene
  LEFT JOIN ki ON sg.Gene=ki.Gene
  WHERE sg.v >= 1 AND p."Secretome location"='Secreted to blood'
)
SELECT Gene, gname, spec, ROUND(sg_ntpm,1) sg, ROUND(lv_ntpm,1) lv, ROUND(pa_ntpm,1) pa, ROUND(ki_ntpm,1) ki,
  ROUND(LOG2((sg_ntpm+1)/(lv_ntpm+1)),4) AS score
FROM cohort
ORDER BY score DESC, Gene ASC
LIMIT 30"}

cohort AS (
  SELECT sg.Gene, sg.gname, sg.v AS sg_ntpm, lv.v AS lv_ntpm, pa.v AS pa_ntpm, ki.v AS ki_ntpm,
         p."RNA tissue specificity" AS spec
  FROM sg
  JOIN proteinatlas p ON sg.Gene=p.Ensembl
  LEFT JOIN lv ON sg.Gene=lv.Gene
  LEFT JOIN pa ON sg.Gene=pa.Gene
  LEFT JOIN ki ON sg.Gene=ki.Gene
  WHERE sg.v >= 1 AND p."Secretome location"='Secreted to blood'
)
SELECT Gene, gname, spec, ROUND(sg_ntpm,1) sg, ROUND(lv_ntpm,1) lv, ROUND(pa_ntpm,1) pa, ROUND(ki_ntpm,1) ki,
  ROUND(LOG2((sg_ntpm+1)/(lv_ntpm+1)),4) AS score
FROM cohort
ORDER BY score DESC, Gene ASC"}

SELECT COUNT(*) total,
 SUM(CASE WHEN p."RNA tissue specificity"='Low tissue specificity' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) low,

 SUM(CASE WHEN p."RNA tissue specificity"='Tissue enriched' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) enr,
 SUM(CASE WHEN p."RNA tissue specificity"='Group enriched' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) grp,

FROM sg JOIN proteinatlas p ON sg.Gene=p.Ensembl WHERE sg.v>=1"}

# Salivary-gland cohort — HPA consensus RNA

**Definition used:** the gene universe is the 20,162 Ensembl genes present in the HPA master table (`proteinatlas`). A gene is counted as *expressed in salivary gland* when its consensus salivary-gland nTPM ≥ 1 (standard HPA expression cutoff). All numbers below come directly from `rna_tissue_consensus` (values per tissue) joined to `proteinatlas` (specificity / protein class / secretome), plus the two blood-concentration tables.
